site.name: Next eclipse
site.description: Countdown to the next solar and lunar eclipse, and a 3D globe of where each one can be seen.
site.footnote: Times are UTC-based; those after 2030 are predictions and may shift by a minute or so. Data: NASA GSFC eclipse catalogs (Espenak & Meeus).
